records.name: coingecko-eth-usd
records.note: Nested float. The market target is in cents, so jq scales and floors.

records.name: coinbase-eth-usd
records.note: Same number, different shape: the amount is a string and needs tonumber.

records.name: kraken-eth-usd
records.note: A third venue, quoting the same asset a few cents away from the others.

records.name: kraken-clock-early
records.note: The same source recorded twice, seconds apart. A market rule is fixed at creation, so a second reading has to come from the same url and the same jq program — only the moment differs. A clock guarantees the two disagree.

records.name: kraken-clock-late
records.note: The second snapshot, taken a few seconds after the first.

records.name: github-not-found
records.note: A real non-200 with a real JSON error body. The first attempt at this used a rate-limited endpoint, which answered 403 once and 200 the next day; a repository that does not exist answers 404 every time.

records.name: html-not-json
records.note: A 200 that jq cannot parse. Exercises the jsonPath failure branch.
